subject: Pricing & next steps — token volumes and budget owner
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@acmeai.com>, Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing & next steps — token volumes and budget owner

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good conversation about the pilot scope and production targets. Quick recap + asks so we can align pricing and get procurement moving: 

1) Estimated token volumes: you mentioned a likely steady-state of ~50–100M tokens/month (chat + few-shot generation). Please confirm whether the 50–100M is monthly or a projected ramp over the first 3 months.

2) Budget range: can you share an approximate monthly/annual budget range for inference so I can model committed vs. on-demand options? (ballpark is fine).

3) Economic buyer / budget owner: who will sign the finance/PO? Jordan, you mentioned finance is involved — can you confirm the budget owner and whether we should loop your procurement team now?

4) Unit economics target: Do you have an internal target $/1M tokens (or equivalent) we should aim to hit with committed pricing? If not, I can propose a few commitment tiers for you to review.

Attached is a first-pass pricing estimate based on the volumes we discussed. Key highlights are in the sheet (committed tier pricing, overage rates, and an example 12-month commit).

Next steps: if you can confirm (a) monthly token target, (b) budget owner / finance timeline, and (c) whether you want a 3/6/12 month committed option, I will send a formal quote + mutual action plan and loop in our procurement/finance lead.

Thanks —
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood-Pricing-Estimate-AcmeAI.xlsx (pricing estimate, 2 sheets)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & next steps — token volumes and budget owner

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A couple quick clarifications: 

- The 50–100M tokens is what we expect at steady-state (monthly). We expect a ramp over the first 6–8 weeks, but please assume 50M as the conservative committed baseline.
- Budget owner will be Priya (CFO). Priya, I’m looping you so you can confirm procurement cadence.
- On unit economics: our finance team is looking for a blended target around $1,000–1,200 per 1M tokens (blended across chat/embedding workload). Can you provide committed/uncommitted breakouts and any volume discounts?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re hoping to have a procurement timeline in the next 2–3 weeks so we can start a pilot in December.

Onward,
Jordan
VP Product, Acme AI

Hi Marissa / Jordan —

Confirmed: I am the budget owner and will own procurement/finance sign-off.

A couple notes from finance: 
- Target blended $/1M tokens is approximately $1,000 (we’re benchmarking against our current provider).
- We need committed pricing options with a clear overage policy (what happens if we exceed committed tokens in a month).
- Also provide a simple annual/quarterly payment option and the potential discount for upfront/annual commit.

Can you add a column in the estimate that shows: committed price, overage price, and net effective $/1M at 50M and 100M levels? That will help our procurement evaluation.

Priya

priya.gupta@acmeai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@acmeai.com>, Jordan Smith <jordan@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & next steps — token volumes and budget owner

Priya / Jordan — thanks for the confirm and helpful guidance. I’ve updated the estimate with the committed vs overage breakout and two example commitment tiers (50M/mo and 100M/mo) plus a 12-month term effective price. Highlights below and attached PDF with detail: 

- 50M/mo commit (12m term): committed rate $900 per 1M tokens; overage rate $1,200 per 1M
- 100M/mo commit (12m term): committed rate $800 per 1M tokens; overage rate $1,150 per 1M
- Monthly billing or 10% discount for annual prepay; example blended effective $/1M at 50M = $900, at 100M = $800 (before any onboarding credits)

I attached a one-page PDF summary and updated spreadsheet: ACME-pricing-breakdown.pdf (summary) and the XLSX has the full line-item math.

Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm which commitment tier (50M or 100M) you want modelled and whether you’d prefer monthly billing vs annual prepay by EOD Friday 11/27.
- I will create a formal quote and mutual action plan and loop our procurement lead.

Aditya (cc’d) — can you confirm whether we have any available onboarding credits/intro discounts we can apply to the pilot? If so I’ll fold those into the quote.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: ACME-pricing-breakdown.pdf, Redwood-Pricing-Estimate-AcmeAI.xlsx

Thanks Marissa — quick internal note and confirmation to include in the thread: 

- We can approve a one-time onboarding credit up to $15k for ACME pilot (to be applied against the first invoice).
- Any additional discounts beyond the listed committed tiers need manager approval; Aditya, please advise if we can extend an extra 5% for a 12m, 100M commit.

Priya — glad to have you as the budget owner. From our side, if you confirm 50M vs 100M and billing cadence this week, we’ll get a formal quote and PO-ready contract over to your procurement team early next week.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
